title: Hierarchical Graph Representation Learning with Pooling-Induced Substructures
abstract: arXiv:2611.14126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical graph-level tasks that require reasoning over substructures that extend beyond local neighborhoods are posing challenges for standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). While graph pooling aims to address this by coarsening graphs into hierarchical representations, existing methods often fail to explicitly preserve the substructures they induce, leading to inconsistent empirical performance. Moreover, evaluating such approaches remains challenging due to the lack of benchmarks with explicit hierarchical structure. We propose Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNNs, an approach to graph pooling that explicitly preserves and processes substructures uncovered by structure-based pooling schemes. We show that this design enhances the expressive power of pooling-based GNNs in the sense of the Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL) test. translated_title: 基于池化诱导子结构的层次图表示学习
translated_abstract: 需要对超出局部邻域范围的子结构进行推理的层次图级任务，正给标准图神经网络（GNN）带来挑战。虽然图池化旨在通过将图粗化为层次表示来解决这一问题，但现有方法往往未能显式保留它们所诱导的子结构，导致实证表现不一致。此外，由于缺乏具有显式层次结构的基准测试，评估此类方法仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了池化子结构感知GNN（Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNNs），这是一种图池化方法，能够显式保留并处理基于结构的池化方案所发现的子结构。我们证明了这种设计在Weisfeiler-Lehman（WL）测试的意义上增强了基于池化的GNN的表达能力。为了实现有原则的评估，我们引入了两个具有可控层次结构的新合成数据集，并提出……
tldr: 该论文提出池化子结构感知GNN，通过显式保留并处理结构池化所诱导的子结构来增强层次图表示学习，在WL测试意义上提升了基于池化的GNN表达能力，并引入了具有可控层次结构的新合成数据集用于系统评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Pooled-Substructure-Aware GNNs, which explicitly preserve and process substructures uncovered by structure-based pooling to enhance hierarchical graph representation learning, improving the expressive power of pooling-based GNNs in the WL test sense, and introduces two new synthetic datasets with controllable hierarchical structure for principled evaluation.
